purpose: Teach: 激突/宝庫/博し/中澤/中尾/江原/大原/大川

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、車両激突事故の交通工学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered vehicle collision engineering research in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, checking in. Steady pace, professional but genuinely curious. Opens with her name as recognition, not correction.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、京都の文化財の宝庫、つまり史料庫の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually focused on Kyoto's cultural repository archives for my research.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Slight pause after the affirmation to signal the correction. Respectful but unashamed of the adjustment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 芸能界で人気を博した役者の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered research on actors who became prominent in entertainment, then?
lines.style: Gently probing, with a listening quality. Not accusatory — genuinely tracking the pattern. Slight upward lilt on the question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、報道写真家中澤氏のドキュメンタリー研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper was actually on photojournalist Nakazawa's documentary research.
lines.style: Patient correction. Speaks with quiet clarity, as if laying out the actual title. Slight firmness that says 'this is what I did.'

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政治学者中尾先生のご研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You focused on political scientist Professor Nakao's work in your paper, yes?
lines.style: Reflective, almost testing. Pause before the question, as if gathering the information. Professional courtesy in the title.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、霊能者江原氏の社会受容の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about spiritual medium Ehara's social acceptance and influence.
lines.style: Even, composed response. Each correction delivered with the same quiet assurance. Not defensive, just factual.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 考古学者大原先生のご研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper covered archaeologist Professor Ohara's research, correct?
lines.style: Steady, slightly slower pace. The rhythm of confirmation seeking. Warm but measured, like she's making sure she has this right.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、報道写真家大川氏の社会写真の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched photojournalist Okawa's documentary photography and its social impact.
lines.style: Final clarity. Calm, assured delivery. Slightly fuller on the last phrase, as if the correction is complete and she can settle into it.
